quantiles.median: standard median of sorted finite samples; even n averages the two middle values
quantiles.p95: nearest-rank: sorted sample at rank ceil(0.95*n), one-based

formal_design.fixed_candidate_fixture: Ten fixed candidates (0..9) cycled in each scenario; this is not a large-repository benchmark.
formal_design.cache_definition: miss/hit refers only to persisted complete commands.json; provider caches are in-memory and cold in each new process.
formal_design.ordering: Variants ran sequentially and are not paired; differences under 1 ms are not assigned causal meaning.

startup.metric: Fresh pwsh adapter first input increment (--with-profile), not full host process startup or full dynamic menu.
